# Lisbon 5-Day Slow-Travel Plan

A relaxed 5-day Lisbon itinerary for 2 adults, built around museums, easy walking, and budget-friendly seafood. Costs are estimated for the full trip excluding flights, with one flexible rainy-day backup.

# Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

## Day 1 — Baixa, Chiado, and Riverside First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take an easy self-guided walk through Baixa and Rossio.
- Afternoon: Visit MUDE or the Lisbon Story Centre, then continue to Praça do Comércio and the riverfront.
- Dinner: Casual seafood meal in Cais do Sodré or near Baixa.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 12**, Food **EUR 70**, Activities **EUR 20**; Total **EUR 102**
- Pace: Light, with plenty of sit-down breaks.

## Day 2 — Alfama, Fado Streets, and a Museum Stop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Slow walk through Alfama, including viewpoints and narrow historic streets.
- Afternoon: Choose one museum: Museu do Fado or Museu do Azulejo.
- Dinner: Affordable grilled fish or seafood rice in a local tavern.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 14**, Food **EUR 78**, Activities **EUR 24**; Total **EUR 116**
- Pace: Moderate, but still easy to trim if you want a shorter day.

## Day 3 — Belém Monuments and Museums
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Tram or taxi to Belém and visit Jerónimos-style landmarks from the outside, then one major museum.
- Afternoon: Pick one: MAAT, Museu Nacional dos Coches, or the Museu de Marinha.
- Dinner: Back in central Lisbon for a simple seafood dinner.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 18**, Food **EUR 72**, Activities **EUR 30**, Treats **EUR 10**; Total **EUR 130**
- Pace: One main district, one main museum, no rush.

## Day 4 — Bairro Alto, Príncipe Real, and a Flexible Walking Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Easy neighborhood walk through Príncipe Real, miradouros, and nearby shops.
- Afternoon: Visit a museum of your choice or keep the afternoon open for a café break and browsing.
- Dinner: Go for a shared seafood platter or petiscos in a less tourist-heavy spot.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 10**, Food **EUR 80**, Activities **EUR 20**; Total **EUR 110**
- Pace: Intentionally flexible, with room to rest.

## Day 5 — Free Morning, Final Museum, and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Slow breakfast, last walk, or a final viewpoint.
- Afternoon: Use for a short museum revisit, shopping, or a café stop before departure.
- Dinner: If staying through dinner, choose one final affordable seafood meal.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 12**, Food **EUR 60**, Activities **EUR 15**; Total **EUR 87**
- Pace: Very light, designed as a buffer day.

## Trip Budget Breakdown

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Local transport | EUR 66 |
| Food and drinks | EUR 360 |
| Activities and museum entries | EUR 109 |
| Treats and flexibility buffer | EUR 10 |
| Contingency reserve | EUR 255 |
| **Planned spend subtotal** | **EUR 545** |

- Your planned daily itinerary comes to about **EUR 545** for 2 adults.
- With your overall cap of **EUR 1,800**, you have a comfortable cushion for nicer meals, extra museum entries, taxis, or a higher-end seafood dinner.
- A practical target is **EUR 700–EUR 1,000 total spent on the ground**, leaving room for spontaneity without stress.

# Rainy-Day Indoor Backup in Lisbon

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Morning: Start at Museu Nacional do Azulejo for a strong indoor cultural stop.
- Afternoon: Move to MAAT, Museu do Fado, or the Lisbon Story Centre depending on location and energy.
- Late afternoon: Pause at a café in Chiado or Baixa before dinner.
- Dinner: Keep it simple with a nearby seafood restaurant or market hall meal.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 14**, Food **EUR 75**, Activities **EUR 25–EUR 35**; Total **EUR 114–EUR 124**
- Best if the weather turns wet: This plan keeps walking short and clusters indoor stops together.

# Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Check museum hours] https://www.visitlisboa.com/
Action: [Button: Plan transit] https://www.carris.pt/
Action: [Button: Find rainy-day options] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/lisbon-things-to-do

- Visit Lisboa: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Carris public transport: https://www.carris.pt/
- Museu Nacional do Azulejo: https://museudoazulejo.gov.pt/
- MAAT: https://www.maat.pt/
